author: John Hammond
description:
This Minecraft security research mod is getting more interesting. We're now exploring real open directories on the internet and viewing file contents inside the game. But that raises a bigger question: how do we sandbox the interaction and keep the environment secure?

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/ncYAPgzjD90?si=9rYPiv5yLWTer-AT
title: Minecraft Security Sandbox
